name: web-yellow-cream-nft-marketplace-hero-with-robot-mascot-and-notched-cards
title: Cream NFT Marketplace Hero with Robot Mascot
whatItIs: A cream and butter-yellow rounded hero with a notched top holding Creator and Collector toggles, a nav, a heavy caps headline 'Let's Discover & Gather Unique NFTs', a phone showing a 3D robot mascot and tilted notched NFT cards with countdown rings, a big 5 with a star and a small map circle.
whatItMeans: Tilted tabbed cards, a friendly robot and warm cream tones make an NFT marketplace feel playful and trustworthy.
techniques: Notched top and card corners like folder tabs
Tilted cards of 3D characters around a phone
Heavy caps headline behind the cards

vocabulary.definition: A card with a cut-out corner or tab.
A circular timer around days, hours and minutes.
A 3D character placed at the centre of a hero.
